propositions: Close operation unconditionally invokes the completion provider via verify_with_auto_resume even when the ticket already carries a cryptographically certified completion-verifier PASS at the exact resolved close SHA.
The signature verification infrastructure can authenticate stored completion op-certs but the close seam never consults the existing attestation before dispatching to the provider.

A reuse-eligible same-ref attested PASS (valid signature, correct SHA pin, matching material fingerprint, not invalidated by reopen) must return zero provider calls while remaining operationally equivalent to a fresh verification.

Attestations that are absent, malformed, unverifiable, stale, differently pinned, invalidated by reopen, non-PASS, or have mismatched material fingerprint must fall through to fresh provider verification.

The reuse check must cryptographically verify the stored completion op-cert and validate that authenticated verified-at-sha equals the resolved close target ref and authenticated material fingerprint equals the ticket's current fingerprint.
